title: ConcernLadder
description: Going-concern / gone-concern confidence ladder mapped onto the capital waterfall (CLD-1). An ordered set of scenarios (Early-Warning 80% -> Severe-Stress 95% -> Liquidation 99.98%/100%), each absorbed by a capital layer in subordination order (loss hits equity -> ... -> debt). Alphas must strictly increase; a loss booked out of subordination order, or a gone-concern scenario mapped to a going-concern soft layer, is REJECTED.

going_gone_boundary_alpha.description: The alpha at which a firm passes from going-concern (survive) to gone-concern (liquidation/creditor protection). CoCos convert here.

capital_stack.description: Layers in subordination order, most-junior (first-loss) FIRST. Cumulative attach/detach points are derived from the amounts.

scenarios.description: The confidence ladder, ordered from lowest to highest alpha.

loss_pool_samples.description: Optional pool loss samples; each layer's absorbed loss is computed via the kernel's structural_transform waterfall for the receipt.
